theme: 美股·中概股名单与市值/市盈率排名及今年以来、近一年阶段收益，话题切换至迪士尼股息率

initial.question: 现在系统里挂着中概股标签的美股，按市值排前五的都有哪几家？
initial.gold_display: 阿里巴巴-W(BABA)1663200、拼多多-W(PDD)1209600、网易-W(NTES)506880、京东-W(JD)323136、百度-W(BIDU)214200（百万美元）
initial.gold_sql: SELECT m.CSNAME, m.SYMBOL, t.F013N FROM AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN m JOIN COM3101 t ON m.FIU_ID=t.FIU_ID WHERE m.IS_CHINESE_STOCK='中概股' ORDER BY t.F013N DESC LIMIT 5

feedbacks.question: 换成按市盈率从低到高排呢？前三名是哪几家？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT m.CSNAME, m.SYMBOL, t.F021N FROM AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN m JOIN COM3101 t ON m.FIU_ID=t.FIU_ID WHERE m.IS_CHINESE_STOCK='中概股' AND t.F021N IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.F021N ASC LIMIT 3

feedbacks.question: 刚才市盈率最低的那三只中概股，今年以来整体走得怎么样？平均涨跌幅有多少？
feedbacks.gold_display: 今年以来平均上涨13.41%（市盈率最低的3只：京东-W、百度-W、理想汽车-W的算术平均，截至2026-08-25）
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(e.CHG_PCT_YTD),2) AS avg_ytd FROM VIEW_US_EXPR_IDX e JOIN (SELECT m.FIU_ID FROM AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN m JOIN COM3101 t ON m.FIU_ID=t.FIU_ID WHERE m.IS_CHINESE_STOCK='中概股' AND t.F021N IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.F021N ASC LIMIT 3) s ON e.FIU_ID=s.FIU_ID WHERE e.TRADE_DATE=(SELECT MAX(TRADE_DATE) FROM VIEW_US_EXPR_IDX)

feedbacks.question: 那把窗口拉长到最近一年呢，平均下来大概什么收益水平？
feedbacks.gold_display: 近一年平均上涨33.96%（仍是这3只：京东-W、百度-W、理想汽车-W的算术平均，截至2026-08-25）
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(e.CHG_PCT_YEAR),2) AS avg_year FROM VIEW_US_EXPR_IDX e JOIN (SELECT m.FIU_ID FROM AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN m JOIN COM3101 t ON m.FIU_ID=t.FIU_ID WHERE m.IS_CHINESE_STOCK='中概股' AND t.F021N IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.F021N ASC LIMIT 3) s ON e.FIU_ID=s.FIU_ID WHERE e.TRADE_DATE=(SELECT MAX(TRADE_DATE) FROM VIEW_US_EXPR_IDX)

feedbacks.question: 行，清楚了。顺便确认下，这些涨跌幅都是按分红拆股调整后的复权口径算的吧？
再看个别的，迪士尼现在的股息率大概什么水平？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT F007N FROM COM3101 WHERE FIU_ID=(SELECT FIU_ID FROM AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN WHERE CSNAME='迪士尼')
